channels: Aggregate and first/second/in counts are actual measured counts. D first/second mixture is a separate hypothesis. first/second channel metrics shown for other families are shared D-channel diagnostics, not independently fitted U/S/I/C/R channel forecasts. Do not interpret repeated channel metrics as independent evidence.
confirmation: No confirmation driver or sealed data access added. A failed retrospective gate prevents confirmation.
history: 50 last legal completed matches per player; no target-event state; 28-day tournament-date embargo; 5 legal decided prior matches per player required for inference
human_baseline: Surface serve vs receiver conceded point rate minus current legal league mean, plus last10 old opponent-adjusted residuals with1000 pseudo-points. Not a complete current-form/physical-state analyst.
licenses: No raw CSV redistribution; permission review required before commercial data/model distribution; external sources documentation only, no scraping/providers purchased.
oracles: Observed point rate through scoring is POSTGAME_ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY, no fitting or promotion. Point-boundary matches excluded only from scalar match oracle (strict interior contract); exact hold oracle endpoints0/1 permitted. Forecast evaluation keeps those rows.
point_hierarchy: 300 tour pseudo-points -> 300 player-overall pseudo-points -> surface-specific pooled counts
return_metric: Return MAE is the exact complement of serve MAE and is not independent corroboration.
scope: RESEARCH_ONLY; incomplete human research due data gaps
scoring: Retain exact Phase1A hold/tiebreak scalar DP. Research extension carries next server and tiebreak count through exact set/match race; set-score and tiebreak-count mass checked. iid stationary points remain a simplifying assumption.
tour_models: ATP and WTA separate state, priors, ranking fits, gates and metrics
uncertainty: Beta-binomial sampling SE only, not certified full match-day uncertainty; receipt marks dependence/day variance, unknown health/rest/travel and weak surface samples. No final-win ad hoc bonus/penalty.
warmup: 2015; ranking/optional stack estimation2016–2019 only. State can update from legally available later results; coefficients never refit on selection or diagnostics.
